text_block_list.text:
On this day, Orfevre departs...
all on her own... to challenge
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
Those seeing her off were her vassals, Dream Journey... and myself.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
"Lady Orfevre...
We shall await the great joy
that our King will bring back to this land."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Or.
...Go and have fun.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

Ever since the day we decided to part ways,
I've interacted with Orfevre normally, but...
to this day, we haven't touched on the heart of the matter.

text_block_list.name: Foreign Trainer
text_block_list.text: ――Hello!

Appearing at the boarding gate was the overseas trainer
entrusted with Orfevre this time. Despite a busy schedule,
they came all the way to Japan just to pick her up.
choice_data_list: (So they really do value it that much.)

text_block_list.name: Foreign Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre.
Pleased to meet you."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Yeah.
choice_data_list: (Orfevre isn't on guard either... thank goodness.)

text_block_list.name: Foreign Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hi, so you're...
her Trainer... aren't you?
choice_data_list: Nice to meet you. Getting right down to business...

text_block_list.text:
While shaking hands, I relay additional notes regarding
Orfevre. Her quirks, personality, and—as crude
as it may be—my concerns heading into the race—

—As I spoke on and on,
suddenly the grip on my hand tightened.

text_block_list.name: Foreign Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
For placing your trust in me.

text_block_list.name: Foreign Trainer
text_block_list.text: I will make Japan's dream come true.

Hearing those impassioned words made my heart swell with warmth.
He understands very well just what kind of race
the "Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe" is to us.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Shall we go?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: W-Wait...!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...!
Damn, made it in time...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I made it in time...!
Ugh, why does this always happen at times like this...?!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Quiet.
I shall take My leave now.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, win this, Orfevre!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
If someone has to wear that crown for the first time...
It pains me to say it, but I'd rather it be you.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Either way, I'm stuck being talked about
alongside you for the rest of my life."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
In that case, if you're gonna do it...
become the greatest Umamusume there is.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Win this.
...Show me the light."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Of course.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainers
text_block_list.text:
"Lady Orfevre...!
May fortune favor your journey!!"

Suddenly, my eyes meet Orfevre's.
There were a mountain of things I wanted to say... but words were largely unnecessary. My feeling was only one—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I know.
And so, Orfevre... carrying the hopes of all of Japan, departed for France.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
was this alright with you?
choice_data_list: Of course I have my own thoughts about it. But—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: We should go with the most reliable, best choice... right?
choice_data_list: ...From your perspective, is it an immature choice?
...From your perspective, is this an immature choice?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Your choice is her choice.
I won't say a word.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Let us watch together.
Watch as that girl changes history—
